# ASC Provider

The ASC provider connects only to infra-gateway and UAM. The supported surface is documented per release.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_url` (String) Authentication endpoint. May be set with ASC_AUTH_URL.
- `endpoint` (String) ASC API endpoint. May be set with ASC_ENDPOINT.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace sent to infra-gateway as X-Tenant. May be set with ASC_NAMESPACE.
- `org` (String) Authentication realm or organization. May be set with ASC_ORG.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret. May be set with ASC_PASSWORD.
- `timeout` (Number) HTTP timeout in seconds. May be set with ASC_TIMEOUT; defaults to 30.
- `username` (String) OAuth client ID. May be set with ASC_USERNAME.
